label: An actual root exists iff the roster is not trapped, is inhabited and root existence is stable
paraphrase: For every profile and world: some actual concretum has no actual concrete ground in the selected relation if and only if the nonempty actual roster is not a borrowing trap, some concrete candidate exists at w, and root existence at w is stable (not-not root existence gives root existence). A premise-free comparison of encodings, proved without excluded middle; it asserts none of the statements compared.
